r0.why: Events and likelihood numbers (1), 0 to 1 with larger more likely (2), percentages 0-100% (3).

r1.why: Fair unbiased coin, equally likely, no other outcomes, 1/2 = 0.5 = 50% (4,5).

r2.why: Axiomatic formalization, listed fields, inferring expected frequency (6), regularities of complex systems (7).

r3.why: Objectivist physical state (10), frequentist long-run repetition (11,12), subjective degree of belief (14), Bayesian expert knowledge plus data (16).

r4.why: Prior from expert knowledge (17), likelihood (18), normalized product gives posterior with all info (19), similar/different priors outcomes (20,21).

r5.why: Latin probabilitas/probity, witness authority, nobility (8); approvable before mid-17th c, sensible people (26,27); modern meaning weight of evidence via induction and inference (9).

r6.why: Gambling interest but exact maths later (23), Cardano 16th c odds (28), Fermat-Pascal 1654 (29), Huygens 1657 (30), Bernoulli and de Moivre branch of maths (31).

r7.why: Simpson 1755 memoir applied theory to observation errors (33), Laplace first two laws (36), second 1778 exponential of square (38), called normal/Gauss law (39).
